data.title: 鸣濑白羽 · 淋浴间瓷砖上的湿润贴合
data.description: 游泳馆闭馆后的淋浴室里，温水从莲蓬头倾泻而下。湿透的连体泳装被拉扯开来，白羽双手撑在湿滑的瓷砖墙壁上，弓着后背在一次次撞击中彻底瘫软。
data.location: steamy tiled communal shower room after hours with water echoing on floor
data.action: 湿透的连体泳装被拉扯开来，白羽双手撑在湿滑的瓷砖墙壁上，弓着后背在一次次撞击中彻底瘫软
data.lighting: dim waterproof overhead lamp creating glistening water trails on smooth porcelain skin
data.camera: rear three quarter view, cowboy shot
data.promptProse: Inside the steam-filled tiled shower room of the closed pool after dusk, Shiroha braces both palms flat against the wet ceramic wall while warm water cascades over her shoulders and back. With her drenched navy school swimsuit pulled aside, she arches her spine and lets out breathless gasps as her partner drives into her from behind. Dim overhead waterproof lighting glints across glistening trails of water and swirling steam along her flushed skin.
data.animaCaption: Bracing both hands against the wet shower tiles with her soaked navy school swimsuit pulled aside, Shiroha arches her back in breathless gasps as her partner thrusts into her from behind under cascading water. Dim overhead light gleams across the steamy tiled room.
data.nsfwProse: Her soaked navy school swimsuit is pulled aside at the crotch as her partner grips her waist and thrusts into her from behind beneath the running shower.
